user.title: School year source
user.description: Fetch compulsory school term dates and breaks from the configured official source.

data_description.url: Official school-year page to fetch. Keep the default unless the source page changes.
data_description.page_check_interval_hours: How often Home Assistant should refetch the official page, in hours. Daily state changes still update at midnight from the cached data.
data_description.include_inferred_long_breaks: Adds summer and Christmas break events by using the gaps between known term end and term start dates. Disable this if you only want breaks explicitly listed on the page.
data_description.poll_hours: How often Home Assistant should refetch the official page, in hours. Daily state changes still update at midnight from the cached data.
data_description.include_inferred_breaks: Adds summer and Christmas break events by using the gaps between known term end and term start dates. Disable this if you only want breaks explicitly listed on the page.
data_description.school_day_lookahead_days: How many days ahead should count as having a school day soon. Default 2 makes the lookahead entity turn on during weekends before Monday and on the last day before school resumes.
data_description.school_menu_lookahead_days: How many days ahead should count as having a school day soon. Default 2 makes the lookahead entity turn on during weekends before Monday and on the last day before school resumes.
